{{Top|leg}}
The '''nank fly''' was an aggressive, stinging [[Insect/Legends|insect]] known to carry some diseases that could prove harmful or fatal to [[Human/Legends|Humans]] but were harmless to [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaughts]]. They could be found in abundance on the [[Ugnaught Surface/Legends|Ugnaught Surface]] due to an [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaanian]] [[Transport/Legends|transport]] crashing on the Surface.<ref name="ActionTidings2">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20041007bespin2|series=Bespin: Action Tidings|text=Part 2: That Den o' Human Iniquity}}</ref>

Chefs and Ugnaughts described nank larvae, or '''nanklings''',<ref name="ActionTidings4">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20041021bespin4|series=Bespin: Action Tidings|text=Part 4: The Empire's Ugly Nose}}</ref> as a rare delicacy, often being flash-fried as one of the most popular items on the menu at [[Zavlabar's Gentes Grill]].<ref name="ActionTidings2" />

The phrase "nank-biters" was once used by [[Ars Fivvle]] to describe [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperials]] that had temporarily taken over [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]], but which the Ugnaughts had eventually helped fight off.<ref name="ActionTidings5">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20041028bespin5|series=Bespin: Action Tidings|text=Part 5: An Exclusive!}}</ref>
